thread:
elaine: Quick — we need to finalize a customer-facing status update for yesterday's partial EU outage. Draft below, looking for copy + timing + who routes inbound leads.

elaine: DRAFT (for status.redwood.ai and email):\n\nWe experienced a partial outage impacting inference requests in the EU region between 03:14–03:42 UTC. Our engineers identified a networking configuration regression and applied a rollback; service was restored at 03:42 UTC. No customer data was exposed. We're running a post-incident review and will share findings and mitigations within 72 hours.\n\nWe recommend: short statuspage entry now, targeted email to Dedicated & Private customers within 2 hours, broader email + blog in 24 hours with postmortem.\n\nmike: copy is clear. I’d tighten the timeline sentence: \"impacted inference requests\" -> \"impacted inference and model-serving requests\" to be explicit.

sophia: +1 on explicitness. Also suggest a subject line for the email to dedicated: \"Service interruption in EU region — what happened and next steps\". For hosted customers we should be more concise.

oliver: Dedicated customers expect direct outreach. Recommend SEs call any customers with >5% traffic on EU or with SLAs. Ops can give a list in 30m. We should not wait for email to call top accounts.

carmen: Support heads-up — inbound routing: expect 20–30 tickets. Can we tag all incident emails with \"incident-eu-2026\" so we can run a quick triage? Also will route potential sales/lead emails to sales-ops so they don't get mixed with CS.

elaine: Good call. We'll add tag. For timing: status page update now (short), targeted email to Dedicated + Private in 2 hours, hosted email 6 hours (short notice + link to status), blog/postmortem 24–72h. Does that work?

mike: Ack. One more copy tweak: replace \"regression\" with \"config change\" — less jargony for customers.

sophia: For the status page we should include \"current status: monitoring\" if any mitigation still in progress. If fully resolved, \"resolved\" and add \"verified by X checks\" (ops can confirm).

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042: EU inference degradation — resolved at 1769000520 (03:42 UTC). Postmortem assigned to @eng-runtime.

oliver: Ops confirms all checks green. Change status to RESOLVED and add \"traffic normalized and health checks passing across EU clusters\".

elaine: Updated draft below (for post to status page and targeted email header):\n\nWe experienced a partial outage affecting inference and model-serving requests in the EU region between 03:14–03:42 UTC. A recent networking configuration change caused degraded routing to some GPU pools. The change was rolled back and services were restored at 03:42 UTC. Traffic and health checks are normal. No customer data was exposed.\n\nWe'll publish a detailed postmortem within 72 hours that outlines root cause, impact, and mitigations. If you have questions, reach out to support (support@redwood.ai) or your dedicated SE.\n\ncarmen: OK to send targeted email now? I have the Dedicated list and Private list ready. Sales-ops standing by for any inbound leads.

elaine: Yes — send to Dedicated/Private now. Carmen please include incident tag and subject suggested by sophia. Mike can you vet headline once more? Then I'll approve.

mike: Headline looks good. Small grammar nit: \"No customer data was exposed.\" -> \"No customer data was exposed as a result of this incident.\" Done.

elaine: Approved. Carmen, please send and cc @mike @oliver. After emails go out, we'll publish the status page entry and pin it on support channels. Also let's schedule the 72h postmortem draft slot on Friday 10:00 UTC.

carmen: Sending now. Tagging: incident-eu-2026. Routing: Dedicated -> account-se, Private -> security. Sales-ops will triage incoming leads and mark any demo requests URGENT.

sophia: For the blog/postmortem, marketing can own the narrative and coordinate with eng for technical appendix. I'll start the outline.

elaine: Thanks all. Closing loop: status updated to RESOLVED, targeted emails sent, sales-ops routing in place. We'll reconvene for the postmortem draft on Friday. :thumbsup:
